title: Arthashastra
hook: Arthashastra: Paramparik roop se 15 adhikarana, 180 prakarana mane jate hain.
exam_points: Paramparik roop se 15 adhikarana, 180 prakarana mane jate hain.
Saptanga rajya: swami, amatya, janapada, durga, kosha, danda, mitra.
Maurya prashasan, rajneeti aur arthvyavastha ka mukhya srot.
